definition: What the corpus holds today, counted by the server rather than written down: the styles at each rank, the element slots every style draws on, the proportion packs, the named errors, the massings and the room groupings.
basis: mcp_server/core.py, the overview whose counts the front door shows: "An evolutionary taxonomy of traditional architecture with an executable" and "proportioning grammar, a kit-of-parts directory per style, and a corpus of". VISION.md, on the element slots, massings and room types: "Three catalogues that every style draws from and none owns."
